question: Owner 2026-11-01 '为什么笔数这么少？收益不是很高！针对这套逻辑做策略优化？以最大利润为目标，重构出新的策略出来，回撤控制小于35%就好了': which touch-close rule and sizing gives the most profit with drawdown < 35 percent, judged out of sample?
approval: Owner 2026-11-01, explicit multi-variable optimization request (recorded in PROJECT_PLAN)
objective: Largest final equity from 1000U over the training window with realized max drawdown < dd_cap and >= min_trades trades; one tie seed
fees: Saved fills of the source: taker entry 0.05 percent, maker target 0.02 percent, taker stop / reclaim exits (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23); 10bp slippage on the market entry and on non-target exits; worse of the two intrabar paths; funding not modelled
not_searched: Reclaim window, stop distances other than 30 / 18, other levels or later touches need new framework fills; pyramiding and profit locks were rejected earlier
in_sample: The score was trained on pre-2025 data; the survivor slice was found with 2025-2026 as its test, so 2025-2026 are not untouched; the walk-forward choice per year uses only earlier years
